teaser.en: Taller than a person and topped with feathery seed heads, this grass reclaims every farm left to rest.
teaser.sw: Ni mrefu kuliko mtu na una vishada vya mbegu kama manyoya juu yake; nyasi hii hurudi kutawala kila shamba linaloachwa kupumzika.

summary.en: *Bondo* is Guinea grass, a tall tufted grass of grassland, forest edges and resting farmland. It is valued as fodder for livestock.
summary.sw: *Bondo* ni *Guinea grass*, nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka katika nyika, kando ya misitu na mashamba yaliyoachwa kupumzika. Huthaminiwa kama lishe ya mifugo.

about.en:
*Bondo* is a tall, tufted grass that grows in dense clumps up to about 2 m high. Its leaves are broad and long for a grass, and its stems end in large, open, branching seed heads that look feathery and airy, often tinged purple.

It grows fast after the rains and forms thick stands that can hide a person.
about.sw:
*Bondo* ni nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka vizito hadi urefu wa takriban m 2. Majani yake ni mapana na marefu kwa nyasi, na mashina yake huishia kwa vishada vikubwa vya mbegu vilivyo wazi na vyenye matawi, vinavyoonekana kama manyoya mepesi, mara nyingi vikiwa na rangi ya zambarau.

Hukua haraka baada ya mvua na kufanya vichaka vizito vinavyoweza kumficha mtu.

where.en: Look for *bondo* in grassland, along forest edges and on fallow land, the fields that farmers leave to rest between crops. It is easiest to recognise when the big open seed heads appear after the rains.
where.sw: Itafute *bondo* katika nyika, kando ya misitu na kwenye mashamba yaliyoachwa, yaani mashamba ambayo wakulima huyaacha yapumzike kati ya mazao. Ni rahisi zaidi kuitambua vishada vikubwa vya mbegu vinapotokea baada ya mvua.

uses.en: *Bondo* is used as fodder. Its broad leaves are tender and palatable, and it is one of the most widely grown fodder grasses in the tropics.
uses.sw: *Bondo* hutumika kama lishe ya mifugo. Majani yake mapana ni laini na yanapendwa na mifugo, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi za lishe zinazopandwa kwa wingi zaidi katika nchi za tropiki.

names.en: Digo: *bondo*, also *gogwe*. The name is shared with Duruma and Giriama. English: Guinea grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Panicum maximum* (now often placed in *Megathyrsus*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *bondo*, pia *gogwe*. Jina hili linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza: *Guinea grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Panicum maximum* (siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika *Megathyrsus*).

reason.en: Another tall grass of grassland and fallow
reason.sw: Nyasi nyingine ndefu ya nyika na mashamba yaliyoachwa

reason.en: Coarse grass of the same fallow land
reason.sw: Nyasi ngumu ya mashamba yale yale yaliyoachwa
